summary:
ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OE THE DISTRICT OR COLUMBIA.

The case is stated in the opinion.
attorneys: Mr. Caleb Cushing for plaintiff in error., Mr. Attorney General for defendant in error.

opinions.author: Swayne
opinions.text:
Mr. Justice Swayne

delivered the opinion of the court.

This also is a writ of error to the Supreme Court of the District of Columbia.

The record discloses the same error which has been considered in the preceding case, No. 14, and the same results must follow.
